verdict: Leads steady over 28 days, but cost per lead is rising this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 174 leads at an average cost of $12.37 per lead, all through Meta — a solid baseline. In the most recent 7 days, however, lead volume dropped 12.2% while cost per lead climbed 16.3%, a pattern consistent with creative wear-out on a single running campaign. Google Business Profile engagement also fell sharply this week, reinforcing a broader dip in inbound intent. Ad creative is being refreshed and a retargeting layer is in progress to relieve pressure on the active campaign. Separately, 33 leads from this period have not yet entered your intake pipeline — that gap is being closed on the CRM side so no inquiry goes unworked.
